I'm trying to reconcile the timeline: readings are supposed to happen every three months, but there's a conflict between mid-June being the next due date per the original request and the landlord's mention of September 15th as the next time. I'm also puzzled by where the photo came from, since the tenant's email seemed to only include a signature with no attachment, yet the agency forwarded a photo to the landlord.

Given the ambiguity, I'll go with the landlord's most recent statement of September 15th as the next scheduled date, set up a recurring follow-up every three months after that, and reply to the landlord confirming this while asking if the quarterly cadence continues going forward. I'll also send the tenant a thank-you note and keep the ticket open since this is a recurring task rather than closing it out.

arguments.purpose: Request solar panel meter reading photo from tenant and send to landlord (landlord asked for 15 September). Then repeat every 3 months per original instruction, unless landlord says otherwise.

arguments.body: Hello Ava, thank you. We have noted that you next need the solar panel reading on 15 September and have set a reminder for that date. Our original instruction was for readings every 3 months. Please could you reply by 24 January to confirm whether you would like us to keep collecting every 3 months after 15 September, or only on dates you give us? Until we hear, we will keep to every 3 months. Kind regards, Northbridge Lettings

Hello Miles, thank you for your help with the solar panel reading. It has been passed to the landlord and nothing more is needed now. We will email you again around 15 September to ask for the next photo. Kind regards, Northbridge Lettings

arguments.note: Recurring solar reading job. Reading photo (display 16845) sent to landlord 17 Jan. Landlord says next due 15 Sept; original instruction was every 3 months, mid June. Treating landlord's latest statement as current; asked her to confirm cadence. Tenant's event 012 email shows no attachment, so the photo's source is unverified. Event 008 names caller as Oakfield Compliance, a mismatch with the tenant. Not closed: recurring.
